text:
maya: Quick sync request 3: can we align on the long-term routing segmentation + launch criteria for the Q3 roadmap? Need something concrete for sales and infra.

sven: Yes. We should define clear tiers (cost-first shard, region-isolate, tenant-island) and for each: SLOs, allowed egress, KV semantics, and required contract.

anya: Customers keep asking for two things: data residency guarantees and consistent p99. They understand tradeoffs if we show numbers.

catalina: Engineering asks: include migration windows, rollback plan, and minimal policy DSL so infra can validate during CI. Keep DSL tiny.

maya: Proposed launch checklist (v0): 1) DSL + unit tests, 2) per-tenant cost estimate script, 3) canary plan (5 tenants), 4) telemetry widgets + alerts, 5) legal/residency note.

sven: Add: chaos test requirement (slow-link, partial region outage) and an automated fallback route to a region-compatible model variant. Document expected p99 delta for cross-region peeking.

anya: Sales needs UI copy: short toggle "Strong Isolation" and a one-liner explaining pricing uplift. Also need a matrix: tier vs. typical multiplier (+x% to +y%).

catalina: Operational detail: for region-isolate, we must decide whether KV peeking is allowed. If yes, note egress multiplier and a configurable peeking TTL. If no, cold-start cost impact must be documented.

maya: Agreed. Decision criteria: allow peeking only if tenant opts in AND cost estimate approved. Default = region-local cache.

sven: Migration constraint: tenant-island requires Reserved Capacity agreement before cutover. Rollback window target: <30 minutes to route back to shared pool variant.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: policy-lab v0 deployed to canary cluster canary-21. Link: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/21

catalina: Example minimal DSL for the one-pager (keep it tiny):
```
policy: {
  tier: "region-isolate",
  affinity: "soft",
  kv_cache: "region-local",
  peeking: "opt-in",
  fallback: "region-compatible-quantized",
  sla_p99_ms: "120"
}
```

maya: Thanks. I'll draft a one-pager with: tier table, launch checklist, DSL snippet, cost multipliers, and the migration playbook stub. Target: end of week.

anya: I'll draft the sales toggle copy and the pricing matrix sample. Sven will validate the SLO numbers with infra.

sven: Will do. Also will run a short sim to estimate p99 delta with peeking on vs off and share numbers.

maya: Final ask: keep v1 surface small. If we ship a compact DSL + defaults and explicit tradeoffs, we reduce risk. Reconvene Wednesday 11am.

catalina: +1. See you then.
